caption_L1: Total and pedestrian fatalities in U.S. traffic crashes from 2001 to 2017 is a area graph. The x-axis plots Year. There is a linear scale from 0 to 6,000 along the y-axis, marked Pedestrian.
caption_L2L3: The pattern in pedestrian fatalities is unsteady. Fatalities reached a low in about 2008 of roughly 4,000, nearly 1,000 fatalities lower than the starting point in 2001. Between 2001 and 2016, fatalities generally increased rapidly to roughly 6,000 before decreasing slightly in 2017.
